metadata.title: Real-mode lift-and-shift cloud migration (offline AgentResult scorer)

architectureBrief.description: Legacy on-prem .NET monolith and SQL Server footprint moving to Azure with minimal refactor; VPN and ExpressRoute backhaul remain during coexistence.
reviewObjectives: Validate cost posture for rehosted IaaS before reservation purchases
Surface network hub risks that threaten regional failover
Identify quick FinOps wins that do not block migration cutover
constraints: RTO target 8h with manual runbooks acceptable for FY26
Data must remain in US regions

inputSummary: Lift-and-shift Windows VM fleet on ExpressRoute hub with SQL on IaaS; seeks rightsizing, reserved instances, and hub failover risks before wave 2 refactor. Synthetic brief for golden cohort expansion.

qualityEvidence.notes: Committed exemplar; point env at live gpt-4o export when running ARCHLUCID_AGENT_EXECUTION_MODE=Real.
